title: Enabling quantum communication in ultra-large-scale networks
summary: The recent development of small-scale quantum networks poses the question of whether such a technology could also operate at scale in the futuristic Quantum Internet. The question can be answered with a classical approach where an arbitrary quantum network is represented as a classical graph, and communication reliability is assessed using methods proper of network theory. Unfortunately, sufficient conditions for viable network-wide communication have been established only for special topologies like regular lattices.
